mapper.insert: insert into user_theme_setting (user_id, mode, active_theme_type, active_theme_key, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{mode}, #{activeThemeType}, #{activeThemeKey}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update active_theme_type = values(active_theme_type), active_theme_key = values(active_theme_key), update_time = values(update_time)
